card.title: Name What It Cost
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Can you understand why I kept rewriting a message you'd never answered, trying to become easier to reply to?

mechanism: A presses for recognition of how unexplained silence changed their sense of being worth answering.
confusable: Unlike troubleshooting communication, A must move from cause of absence to its experienced emotional burden.
comparison: D75-b reveals self-editing to become easier to answer; D75-a reveals continued expectation at an empty seat.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
